key_decisions: Fabio 2026-10-29: no Pod. No 12 GB cards to rent in Poland and the Pod minimum is 16 GB, so the second size is measured by CAPPING VRAM on the local 16 GB bench.

Auto = 16 GB ladder x memory scale: exactly the ladder at 14-16 GiB usable (desktop noise band), linear from the nearer edge outside. Usable = comfy get_free_memory + loaded models' loaded memory on the model's load_device.
System RAM is NOT used: ComfyUI streams offloaded weights from RAM, so short RAM costs speed, not activation VRAM. Fabio has not ruled on this; raise it if he asks.
Graphs keep the Window Frames MpiMath node with expression "0" (one scalar, per the raw-edit rule) rather than deleting the node.
constraints: A capped torch fraction must cap what comfy SEES too: get_free_memory reads cuda mem_get_info (hardware), so the auto path would still see 16 GB. Either pass window_frames explicitly per run, or also make comfy plan for the cap (--reserve-vram 4). Measure the OOM edge with explicit values, then check auto's number against it.
GPU is shared: wrap every bench run in gpu_lease.py run; the bench is G:\ComfyUi on its own port, never :3000 / :48188. Its MpiNodes is the linked C:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes working repo.
